intro.title: Let’s measure how you walk
intro.overground: You will walk across the picture and back a few times, side on to the phone. You can then add a walk toward the phone if you like.
intro.pad: You will walk on the walking pad at a speed that feels comfortable, with the phone at your side and then in front of you.
intro.both: You will walk on the floor or on the walking pad, at a speed that feels comfortable.

mode.title: Where will you walk today?
mode.padNote: With your helper beside you the whole time

gear.title: What are you wearing for the walk today?
gear.brace: Do you wear a brace on a leg?

path.title: Get your walking path ready
path.length: About 3 metres of clear floor is enough.

place.frontTitle: Place the phone at the end of your path
place.front1: Stand the phone upright against a wall or on a shelf, at about hip height.
place.front2: Start about 4 metres away, facing the phone.
place.front3: Walk toward the phone, stop a step or two before it, turn and walk back.
place.frontCaption: Toward the phone, a turn before it, and back
place.sideTitle: Place the phone to see you from the side
place.side1: Stand the phone against a wall or on a shelf, at about hip height. Sideways is best.
place.side2: Walk about 3 metres away from the phone, side on to it.
place.side3: Walk across the picture, stop, turn and walk back. You do not need to leave the picture.
place.sideCaption: Side on to the phone, about 3 metres away, across and back
place.padSideTitle: Place the phone on your {side} side
place.padSideMoveTitle: Move the phone to your {side} side
place.padSide1: Set the phone sideways on a stand, at about hip height.
place.padSide2: Put it about 3 metres away, facing the middle of the belt.
place.padFrontTitle: Place the phone in front of you
place.padFront1: Stand the phone upright on a stand, about 1 metre high.
place.padFront2: Put it 2 metres in front of the pad, in line with the belt.
place.tilted: Straighten the phone so it is level
place.preview: Make sure your whole body shows in the picture.

pad.floor1: The floor is level, with clear space behind the pad.
pad.floor2: Your helper stays close to the stop button.
pad.support1: Hold the front bar, or a steady support on the side away from the phone.
pad.support2: Your helper stands behind you, on the phone’s side.
pad.on1: Step on while the belt is stopped, and hold the support.
pad.start1: Start at the slowest speed and raise it until it feels like your comfortable walk.
pad.startAgain: Start the pad at the same speed, and hold the support until your walk settles.
pad.tooFast: The slowest speed is too fast for me
pad.warm1: Walk at your comfortable speed. We start measuring after the warm up.
pad.speed: What speed did you walk at?
pad.handrail: How did you hold the support while walking?

stand.frontTitle: Stand about 4 metres from the phone, facing it
stand.sideTitle: Stand side on to the phone, about 3 metres away
stand.padTitle: Stand still on the stopped pad

walk.frontTitle: Walk toward the phone, turn before it and walk back
walk.sideTitle: Walk across the picture and back
walk.sideBody: Stop and turn inside the picture whenever you like. Each way counts.
walk.frontBody: You do not need to walk past the phone. Each way counts.
walk.sideSay: Walk across the picture, stop, turn and walk back, at your usual pace.
walk.frontSay: Walk toward the phone, turn a step or two before it, and walk back, at your usual pace.
walk.moreBody: We need a few more steps to see both sides clearly.
walk.padBody: Keep walking until the count ends.

again.title: Tell us if the pain grows
again.body: Walk again when you are ready, within your comfort.

offer.title: Add a walk toward the phone?
offer.body: It is optional and takes about a minute. We see your walk from the front as well.

retry.title: Let’s do this part again
retry.skip: Go on with what we have

reason.side_on: Stand side on to the phone, about 3 metres away, and walk across the picture.
reason.face_phone: Face the phone and walk toward it, then turn before it and walk back.
reason.no_person: We could not see you. Check that your whole body shows in the picture.
reason.light: Turn on more light, and keep the phone still.
reason.whole_body: Move the phone back a little, so your feet show the whole time.
reason.more_steps: Walk a little further each way, across the whole picture.
reason.one_person: Only you in the picture, please. Your helper stays behind you.

stance.placeOverground: Stand about 2 metres in front of the phone, beside something steady to hold.
stance.placePad: Stay on the stopped pad facing the phone, with your fingertips on the support.
stance.liftBody: Lift your other foot a little, and put it down whenever you want.

hint.no_person: We cannot see you in the picture
hint.second_person: We see someone close to you. Your helper stays behind you
hint.feet: We need to see both feet
hint.legs: Move the phone a little so your whole leg shows
hint.light: More light helps us see your steps
hint.level: Straighten the phone so it is level

save.error: We could not save your walk. Check your connection and try again.

nothing.title: We did not measure your walk this time
nothing.body: We will go on with the rest of the check.

done.title: Your walk is saved
done.later: Your walking results are complete after the last part of the check.

card.title: How you walk
card.padSpeed: km an hour on the pad
card.replay: One step cycle of your walk
card.unclear: We could not see your steps clearly enough this time.
